note: Alleghany County NC has no countywide zoning (unincorporated land is subdivision/land-use regulated only; 1999 Roaring Gap land use district ordinance). Town of Sparta has zoning (Chapter 156, Official Zoning Map), but no queryable zoning district service was found: the county webgis MapServer (49 layers) has Sparta Limits and Sparta ETJ but no zoning layer; ArcGIS Hub/Online searches for Sparta/Alleghany zoning returned only unrelated items; the town's zoning map appears only as PDF/image.
